text_block_list.text: On Christmas Day—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas!

A Christmas party was being held in the 
Trainer's Room, having invited Mejiro 
Ardan's friends alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, getting ready for the party 
together was so much fun! It kind of 
reminded me of back home!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite used to celebrations like 
this... but I'm truly glad to be sharing 
this seat with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
On the contrary, I am the one who is truly 
delighted to be able to hold this party 
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This, too... is only possible because of 
all the "presents" I have accumulated 
together with the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san...――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I intend for today to double as a year-end 
party, so I hope we can spend a wonderful 
time reminiscing about the journey we have 
walked together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So much happened this year, didn't it...! 
What I just can't forget, of course, is 
the Takarazuka Kinen's—

Gathered around the food, Mejiro Ardan and 
her friends delightfully reminisced about 
the overlapping hoofprints they had left 
behind—
Before long, the sun began to set—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Are you sure this is all right? Leaving 
Ardan-san and the Trainer to clean up all 
by themselves...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am the host, so please don't worry 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then Yaeno-san and I will head back first! 
Thank you very much, Ardan-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Yaeno-san, you're coming with me 
to the after-party~! I'm not letting you 
go tonight!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-Ah, y-yes, understood!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Please do your best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you very much, Chiyono O-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the wonderful time 
today. I truly hope we can... hold another 
party like this next year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Let's do this again next year, 
and for years to come!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, I shall rush to your 
side, even if I must cross the ends of the 
earth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I am deeply grateful.

After seeing off Sakura Chiyono O and 
Yaeno Muteki—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. But after that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Why don't we do it too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: An "after-party," of course♪

After tidying up the trainer's office, 
Mejiro Ardan changed clothes and led me 
out to take a walk through the nighttime 
city together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wanted to see the city streets on 
Christmas night with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Given that I tended to stay cooped up in 
the mansion, my opportunities to see these 
town sights with my own eyes were rather 
limited—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Besides, I really wanted to try 
having an "after-party" today, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am very happy that I could do both 
together with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Knowing that this can only be seen 
during this season gives it a truly 
profound charm."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It feels just like being in an ocean of 
stars.

Watching Mejiro Ardan smile as she spoke, 
an idea suddenly struck me.
choice_data_list:
Shall we go see an even bigger sea of 
stars?

Want to go see an even bigger sea of 
stars?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh—

Walking through the night city while 
chatting with Mejiro Ardan, we arrived at 
a planetarium—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea there was a planetarium in a 
place like this.
choice_data_list: I'm glad it happened to be open.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. It's been a while since I last 
visited a planetarium, so my heart's 
fluttering a little."

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"And so, we shall now guide everyone on a 
cosmic journey among the stars adorning 
this holy night."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: How wonderful...—

Considering everything Mejiro Ardan has 
done for me, this doesn't even begin to 
repay her. In fact—

"Her expression as she looked up at the 
starry sky beside me, her breathing, the 
sparkle in her eyes—I felt as though she 
had given me yet another precious gift—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I couldn't help but be captivated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Thank you for such a wonderful 
time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ......Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to look up at the stars like this 
together with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, without fail...!

It became an unforgettable night, having 
exchanged an important promise tied to the 
"future" with Mejiro Ardan...

And so, after wrapping up the after-party 
and walking Mejiro Ardan back to the 
dorms—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Thank you so much for today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We got to have the party, and an 
after-party... and you even invited me to 
this wonderful sea of stars...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you... this has become an 
unforgettable Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...The lights twinkling above our heads 
are the past glimmerings of stars shining 
across distant space reaching us—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even that exceptionally dazzling light 
might be nothing more than the remnants... 
of a star that no longer exists.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And here we are "now," looking up at that 
star together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And the words we wove as we looked up at 
the stars will carry on beyond "now" and 
into the future, as memories or keepsakes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm... to you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Did you... become a star?
choice_data_list:
You were the most beautiful star I saw 
today.

You were the most beautiful star I saw 
today!

text_block_list.text:
Reflecting the starlight at the 
planetarium, her eyes held a pure and 
brilliant shine that I will surely never 
forget for the rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Me too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The breath of the stars that I felt so 
close to me all day today... I will hold 
it deep within my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As long as this life endures.

A day will come when I look back and 
remember the sparkle of the stars I saw 
today.

It became an unforgettable night, one that 
made me certain of it—
